claims: National Burrito Day 2026 is Thursday, April 2.
National Burrito Day is celebrated annually on the first Thursday of April.
Chipotle Rewards members can win free burritos or BOGO entrees by playing the "Burrito Vault" game.
Qdoba Rewards members get a free burrito or bowl with the purchase of an entree and drink.
Baja Fresh sells $5 chicken burritos in-store.
Baja Fresh offers $5 off a $20 purchase for reward members.
Bubbakoo's Burritos offers BOGO free burritos when ordering online/in-app with code BURRITODAY.
Del Taco offers a free Classic Burrito with any $3 purchase for rewards members.
Moe's Southwest Grill offers BOGO burritos, bowls, or Moe Value Meals for Rewards members.
El Pollo Loco offers BOGO a la carte burritos for Loco Rewards members.
